task.title: Helm and OCI prerequisites
task.shortdesc: Before you use Helm charts with Red Hat Quay, you can install a supported Helm client and trust registry certificates. OCI chart support requires a compatible Helm version.

context.p: Helm simplifies how applications are packaged and deployed. Helm uses a packaging format called Charts which contain the Kubernetes resources representing an application. supports Helm charts so long as they are a version supported by OCI.
You can download the most recent version of Helm from the Helm releases page.
